phones.notes: ITU/ICTA confirms the migration of non-geographic mobile numbers to eight digits and a public 707X XXXX mobile allocation. The existing 5-leading mobile-style range is retained as a conservative review prefix; generated numbers are not portability-checked.

source.title: Mauritius National Identity Card Act text

national_identity_card_number.notes: The Act confirms the card records an NIC number. No current official public grammar, checksum or semantic digit logic was confirmed; NIC is a generator marker, not a claimed literal prefix.
